title: Local triage verdict record
description: reports/<area>/handoff/<check>-<engine>-<stamp>.verdict.json: the machine-readable file a local-model triage run writes beside its markdown evidence (runLocalModel in admin/routes/remediation.mjs). It is written only when a verdict was read from the reply. This schema fixes the envelope. The verdict inside is the one the engine was told to produce against schema/triage-verdict.schema.json; the server checks only that it has a verdict string and a findings array before writing it, and a verdict salvaged from the reasoning channel was never under the engine's enforcement, so the rest of its shape is not frozen here.

check.description: The manifest check whose artifact was triaged.

engine.description: The declared local host id that answered.

answeredBy.description: Which server answered, as lib/model-provider.mjs records it. Absent from files written before it was recorded.

project.description: The area the run was scoped to.

artifact.description: Path of the scanner artifact sent to the model; null when none was found and the model reasoned from counts only.

artifactTruncated.description: Only the first part of the artifact was sent, so the verdict is a floor.

verdictSalvaged.description: The verdict was recovered from the model's reasoning channel, not from its reply. Absent means the verdict was not salvaged.
